usda-plants.name: USDA PLANTS Database
usda-plants.termsSummary: Plant information, lists, and distribution maps are not copyrighted and are free for any use, with citation. Images vary per file.
usda-plants.citation: USDA, NRCS. {year}. The PLANTS Database (https://plants.usda.gov, {accessed}). National Plant Data Team, Greensboro, NC USA.

staff-observation.name: Staff observation
staff-observation.termsSummary: A colleague's own professional observation, cited only for a trait no other registered source gives.

king-county-native-plant-guide.name: Native Plant Guide for Western Washington Yards
king-county-native-plant-guide.publisher: King County Department of Natural Resources and Parks, Water and Land Resources Division
king-county-native-plant-guide.termsSummary: The 2017 brochure (read from a copy the owner uploaded) states no copyright, license, or reuse terms, and the terms of the county site couldn't be read from the session. By the owner's decision (D18) it is cited for facts only: common names, leaf habit, sun, moisture, and mature height. Its prose, plant list layout, and illustrations are never copied.
king-county-native-plant-guide.citation: King County Department of Natural Resources and Parks. {year}. Native Plant Guide for Western Washington Yards (https://kingcounty.gov/gonative, {accessed}).

wikidata.name: Wikidata
wikidata.termsSummary: Read through the Wikidata taxonomy box on Wikimedia Commons category pages, since wikidata.org is blocked from cloud sessions. Commons' licensing page says structured data is CC0; Wikidata's own terms page couldn't be opened. Prototype only (D20): cited for family.
wikidata.citation: Wikidata contributors. {year}. Wikidata, via the Wikimedia Commons taxonomy box (https://www.wikidata.org, {accessed}).

portland-plant-list.name: Portland Plant List
portland-plant-list.publisher: City of Portland Bureau of Planning and Sustainability
portland-plant-list.termsSummary: The June 2016 update (read from a copy the owner uploaded to docs/) states no copyright, license, or reuse terms, and the city's sites couldn't be reached from the session. Registered for facts only, like the King County guide (D18, D23): common names, form, foliage, height, spread, growth rate, sun, moisture, and bloom. Its prose, tables, and illustrations are never copied. The URL is the bureau address the document gives.
portland-plant-list.citation: City of Portland Bureau of Planning and Sustainability. 2016. Portland Plant List, June 2016 update (https://www.portlandonline.com/bps, {accessed}).

placeholder.name: Placeholder
placeholder.termsSummary: Not a source. It stands in for a required field (family or form) that no reference document gives, so a prototype fixture passes validation (D24). Its value is not a fact; npm run coverage lists every use, and each is replaced from a real source.
placeholder.citation: Placeholder: no reference document gave this value.

census-tiger.name: TIGER/Line Shapefiles
census-tiger.termsSummary: Read in the metadata shipped with each 2026 shapefile (census.gov itself couldn't be reached): the products are not copyrighted and are free to use, with acknowledgement of the U.S. Census Bureau as the source. TIGER/Line is a Census Bureau trademark, and its boundaries are statistical, not legal or jurisdictional determinations. Used for the state, county, and place layers in geo/.

epa-ecoregions.name: Level III Ecoregions of the Conterminous United States
epa-ecoregions.publisher: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency, Office of Research and Development
epa-ecoregions.termsSummary: The dataset's metadata states no access or use constraints and asks that the EPA be acknowledged; the data carries no warranty. Used for the ecoregion layer in geo/.
epa-ecoregions.citation: U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. {year}. Level III Ecoregions of the Conterminous United States (https://dmap-prod-oms-edc.s3.us-east-1.amazonaws.com/ORD/Ecoregions/us/Eco_Level_III_US.html, {accessed}). Corvallis, OR: U.S. EPA Office of Research and Development.
